selection.selectionRule: Reuse the untouched, previously frozen PeerQA fresh-validation split without inspecting qwen3.8-max predictions.

scalingComparison.design: Compare direct-model and ReviewX-assisted arms at each model generation under the same split and per-paper budget. Report both within-model ReviewX gain and between-model scaling gain.

primaryMetric: expert-question coverage after blind human annotation

secondaryOperationalAnalysis.name: ReviewX full-audit coverage upper bound
secondaryOperationalAnalysis.allowedUse: Characterize the high-recall audit workflow and the cost of presenting the complete local finding set.
secondaryOperationalAnalysis.prohibitedUse: Do not use this unequal-output analysis to claim method superiority.

analysisRule: Do not tune prompts, thresholds, ranking, or budgets after opening qwen3.8-max predictions. Report all failures and confidence intervals.
reportingBoundary: Automatic alignment is a retrieval-oriented proxy for candidate generation, not expert recall or review correctness. Historical qwen3.7 runs are reused without rerunning or cherry-picking.
